item.title: Full Feed Article
item.content:encoded: This fixture contains a deliberately long feed-provided article body. It has enough text to be treated as complete by the portable extractor. The paragraph repeats useful context about feeds, source provenance, validation, windows, cursors, and article extraction. The purpose is to ensure the full-text script can choose feed_content before trying page extraction. This article body is synthetic and intentionally verbose so the character count crosses the complete-content threshold for tests.
